name: @teacher-assistant/verify-dashboard
description: CI generator for the TRACK Verification dashboard: a product-agnostic engine/ (journey ingest from Playwright evidence, provenance/UNVERIFIED, counts, CI pills, renderers) driven by a per-product config/. Produces a static index.html + the ingested videos/traces, packaged into the teacher-assistant-verify nginx image (GHCR), served privately on Lexington. Not shipped in any app image.
